name: PHANTOM SHIFT
author: Sergey Poznyak
description: Switch your light on and off to phase between two worlds and find your way through 3 levels - just don't phase into a wall! A 1-bit jam entry.

descriptions.en: Switch your light on and off to phase between two worlds and find your way through 3 levels - just don't phase into a wall! A 1-bit jam entry.
descriptions.it: Accendi e spegni la luce per passare da un mondo all'altro e superare 3 livelli, ma attento a non riapparire dentro un muro! Creato per una 1-bit jam.
